scenario_name: CSE Block Network Outage & Emerging Crisis

payload.description: WiFi isn't working at all in the CSE Block. Connected but says no internet.

expected_outcome.demo_note: Initial isolated report. Creates anchor incident.

payload.description: Internet has been completely down since morning in CSE Lab 3. We cannot load our lab assignments.

expected_outcome.correlation_reason: High semantic similarity (0.91), exact building match [CSE Block], category [NETWORK], within 20 minutes.
expected_outcome.demo_note: Second report correlates! Shows system recognizing non-isolated pattern.

payload.description: CSE Lab 4 cannot connect to campus WiFi or access local servers. Class is paused.

expected_outcome.demo_note: CRITICAL MOMENT: 3rd report in 45m triggers EMERGING INCIDENT spike! Admin dashboard flashes alert.

payload.description: Network is extremely slow across entire CSE Block. Access points keep dropping.

expected_outcome.demo_note: Further strengthens the incident cluster. AI summary updates with urgent recommendation to inspect core switch.

payload.description: Major water pipe leaking near the 2nd floor restrooms in Central Library, water seeping into study room.

expected_outcome.demo_note: Unrelated issue: system correctly does NOT cluster this into the network incident despite concurrent timing.

payload.description: Air conditioning unit in Science Annex Room 102 is blowing warm air and making a loud rattling sound.

expected_outcome.demo_note: Creates third independent incident. Demonstrates multi-incident categorization.
